wikis.name: physics
wikis.description: Curated, fact-checked physics synthesis wiki — verified-or-honestly-labelled results (Pub/JO/CAS/Agent/Unv). PUBLISHABLE tier (can be made public).
wikis.notes: Own colocated jj repo (never push without being asked). Publishable tier of a two-tier wiki; its private sibling is 'physics-private'. Structure: physics_index -> <section>_map -> pages; standing pages conventions/notation_index/glossary. Run scripts/wiki_ci.py before committing. Read README.md in the wiki root before writing pages.

wikis.name: physics-private
wikis.description: Private, verified-only wiki for you + collaborators — unpublished results promoted from the notebook. PRIVATE tier; promotable onward to the public 'physics' wiki.
wikis.notes: Own colocated jj repo (private research — never push without being asked). Verified-only (markers JO/CAS/Agent, never Unv). Structure: by section like 'physics', and EACH section dir carries a verification/ folder that is the source of truth (calculation + checks + receipt/ledger) backing its pages — per section, not per page. Links both ways with 'physics' via relative sibling paths. Promotion ladder: notebook -> private -> public.
